required_inputs.network: external bus ids, bus/gen/branch source matrices and internal-index map
required_inputs.operating_point: source Pg plans, Vset, true Q/P/V limits, topology, baseMVA and control; rateA zero means unavailable, no adjusted dispatch
required_inputs.random_input_retention: all attempted samples, not only successes

required_states.voltage_complex: complex array [N,n_bus], NaN for unevaluable with explicit status
required_states.status: evaluated | input_invalid | no_regulation_or_balance | ac_nonconvergence | island_unsupported | unsupported_model
required_states.residuals: P/Q/V2 separately in p.u. or p.u.^2
required_states.cost: fast iterations, fallback, controller outer steps, full AC inner calls, wall and CPU time
required_states.operating_violations: Pg/Qg/V flags; MVA loading unavailable when rateA=0

branch_sample_arrays.reason: avoid redundant full-size arrays; all branch samples can be reconstructed from retained voltage, exact source network, internal mapping and frozen Yf/Yt
must_retain: reconstruction code SHA and actual command

models.model_modes: statistical components have no assumed control-mode labels

tables.errors: absolute physical differences; relative only with declared adequate denominator; undefined remains null

unconditional_interpretation: Unevaluable mass separate; normalized successful TMM is conditional on evaluability.

generator_probability_scope.available: AC-MC empirical statistics and matched-input fast/AC outputs
generator_probability_scope.reason: Generator output equals network injection plus random bus demand minus fixed stochastic injections; voltage alone does not identify their joint law. Do not assume independence or invent a TMM generator curve.
